title: When the pressure gets too much for a manual spreadsheet system
outcome: Variable pay administration moved off Excel onto a governed platform
challenge: Variable pay was administered in Excel. The spreadsheets couldn't keep up with plan complexity, and errors were eroding rep trust — but the team was wary of change.
whatWeDid: We implemented an SPM platform sized to the plans, migrated the spreadsheet logic, and ran change management so admins and reps came along.
results: Plan logic moved into a governed platform
